title: Production login, pipeshare.live routing, and faster deletes
description:
PipeShare BASE sign-in now lives at https://pipeshare.live/ with a cleaner production login layout, brand colors, and renamed theme labels (Horizon Brand, Abyssal Blue, Ember Shell). The HorizonPipe marketing site is at https://pipeshare.live/Horizonpipe/.

Deletes no longer sit on a false empty wait: items leave the list immediately, then finish on Wasabi with batched DeleteObjects. Build Billable Package copies files through a new server-side batch CopyObject API instead of one browser request per file.

Who is affected: everyone on the private server (pipeshare.live). SaaS (pipeshare.net) landing is unchanged until Push; delete/copy speed improvements apply on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: https://pipeshare.live/ is the PipeShare BASE login; HorizonPipe site is at /Horizonpipe/.
Login screen redesigned for production (cleaner layout, brand orange CTAs, theme picker refined).
Theme labels renamed to Horizon Brand, Abyssal Blue, and Ember Shell.
Remember username and password option (username saved on device; browser can save the password).
Deletes remove items from the explorer immediately, then finish on Wasabi in the background.
Folder delete/move uses batched Wasabi DeleteObjects; billable packages use server batch CopyObject.
